Notes
*1 Three MCP tools through the Gateway
list_files / read_file / search_files. Tool names arrive as
targetName___toolName
*2 Keep the Gateway and the Lambda in one Region
Cross-Region Lambda invocation is not available, so place the Gateway,
the Lambda, and the S3 AP in the same Region
